newsitem.title: USA: Choice Hotels to buy back up to 6 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Choice Hotels to buy back up to 6 mln shrs.

text.p: Choice Hotels International Inc said on Monday its board approved the repurchase of up to six million common shares.

Choice Hotels, which has 62.9 million shares outstanding, said the purchases will be made from time to time in the open market, subject to market conditions and the limitations within the company's credit facilities.
Repurchased shares will be held in treasury and may be used for general corporate purposes, including future acquisitions and stock-based employee and director benefit plans, Choice Hotels said.
